      # macOS exposes the required nonreaping waitid/WNOWAIT API in this runtime.
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ runner.os == 'macOS' && '3.14' || '3.12' }}
- name: Verify portable source-bound point input exports

extensions.name: matched_owner_matrix
extensions.anchor_after: # The suite reports which local-artifact oracles are unavailable in a clean clone.

replacements.current:
- name: Verify matched342 owner contract engineering controls
        run: python -I -B -X utf8 test/matched_initial342/profile_owner_tests.py --output-directory "$RUNNER_TEMP/matched342-owner-contracts"
      - name: Verify matched342 owner lifecycle engineering controls
        run: python -I -B -X utf8 test/matched_initial342/test_native_owner_lifecycle.py --output-directory "$RUNNER_TEMP/matched342-owner-lifecycle"
      - name: Record the deliberate owner artifact omission and byte scope
        if: always()
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf '%s\n' \
            'excluded_path=matched342-owner-contracts/test_native_predicates_reject_modified_observations/oversize.raw' \
            'fixture_bytes=67108865' \
            'reason=deliberate sparse over-64MiB rejection fixture; ordinary native evidence is retained unchanged' \
            'hardlinks=runtime-only identity assertions; artifacts retain file bytes, not native hardlink relationships' \
            'scope=artifact exclusion pattern; fixture presence is not asserted' \
            > "$RUNNER_TEMP/matched342-owner-ARTIFACT_NOTES.txt"
      - name: Retain complete matched342 owner engineering evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: matched342-owner-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.julia-version }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/matched342-owner-contracts
            ${{ runner.temp }}/matched342-owner-lifecycle
            ${{ runner.temp }}/matched342-owner-ARTIFACT_NOTES.txt
            !${{ runner.temp }}/matched342-owner-contracts/test_native_predicates_reject_modified_observations/oversize.raw
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 6
